data.one_liner: A collection of animated progress indicators and text animators for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides various pre-built animated progress indicators and text animation widgets like FadingText, JumpingText, ScalingText, JumpingDots, HeartbeatProgressIndicator, and GlowingProgressIndicator. It helps developers easily add loading states and text effects to their Flutter applications.
use_when: You need standard animated loading indicators like jumping dots or glowing icons.
You want animated text effects such as fading or jumping loading text.
avoid_when: You require complex physics-based motion or heavy Lottie/Rive animations.
You need advanced custom charting or data visualization.
strengths: Ready-to-use collection of common progress and text animation widgets.
Simple API with customizable options like font size and child widgets.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific set of predefined indicators and text animators.
Not many recent updates documented besides null-safety support.
